completion_contract.coverage_definition: Fraction of Copernicus GLO-90 tileList land tiles whose elevation COG was opened and processed. Ocean has no DEM tile; this is not a claim of ocean coverage.

source.license: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 general-public licence; see provider terms

method.unit_of_analysis: Non-overlapping 6x6-cell windows, nominally ~5.55 km x ~5.55 km at ~925 m support, in each one-degree land tile
method.resampling: GLO-90 COG resampled by area averaging to a local metric CRS at 925 m nominal cell size
method.secondary_ranking_role: Diagnostic only; not averaged into the primary score or used to order the global shortlist.
method.secondary_features_role: Alternative terrain diagnostics used to assess metric-family rank robustness; derived from the same DEM source and not independent-source validation.
method.score: Core primary index and secondary diagnostic index are calculated separately as 100*exp(-mean normalized absolute feature gap), using IQR scales from the ten-site Earth reference pack. The global shortlist is ordered by core_terrain_index only; no blended consensus score is produced.

feature_families.secondary_note: Alternative diagnostic feature family from the same DEM grids; it tests metric-family robustness, not independent-source accuracy.
Alternative diagnostic feature family from the same DEM grids; it tests metric-family robustness, not independent-source accuracy.
Alternative diagnostic feature family from the same DEM grids; it tests metric-family robustness, not independent-source accuracy.

target_reference_sources.moon: NASA LRO LOLA GDR LDEM_80S_80M, regional Shackleton Rim grid
target_reference_sources.mars: NASA MGS MOLA MEGDR 64 ppd, regional Nili Patera grid

method.validity: At least 70% of 36 elevation cells and at least 15 valid slope and relief derivatives
method.window_sampling: Non-overlapping stride equal to six cells to reduce compute and avoid duplicate adjacent windows; windows are not statistically independent at broader spatial scales.
method.interpretation: A terrain-screening lead only. Score is not a probability, calibrated accuracy, geological equivalence, resource estimate, operational suitability, or landing/rover safety.

feature_families.secondary_note: Alternative diagnostic feature family from the same DEM grids; it tests metric-family robustness, not independent-source accuracy.

moon.shortlist_method: Top 1,200 by primary core terrain index, capped at three candidates per 1-degree source tile; secondary index is diagnostic only

candidate_windows.ranking_role: core_terrain_index_only; secondary_diagnostic_index is reported separately and not averaged
candidate_windows.interpretation: Global terrain-screening lead only; not a geological analog, field validation, resource assessment, rover-safety or landing-suitability result.

limitations: Land-cover classes are machine-learning predictions from annual Sentinel-2 composites, not field observations or detailed lithology/mineralogy.
The source collection reports assessed average accuracy above 75%; accuracy varies by class, geography and conditions.
Pixels are resampled by modal class to a 30 m local analysis grid; this does not create 30 m native source information.
No-data pixels are excluded from class fractions and are reported separately.
This enrichment is applied only to retained global terrain shortlist windows, not every global terrain window.

coordinate.coordinate_status: approximate DEM-window centre; not a field station

source.title: NASA/POWER Source Native Resolution Climatology Climatologies

limitations: NASA POWER is gridded climatology, not a local weather-station observation or current forecast.
T2M is 2 m air temperature, not rock or surface temperature.
WS10M is wind speed at 10 m and does not estimate dust emission or deposition.
PRECTOTCORR is precipitation and is not evidence of surface/subsurface water or ice resources.
ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN is Earth atmospheric solar irradiance, not lunar illumination.
Candidate coordinates are approximate centers derived from a resampled DEM tile and are not survey-grade field station locations.

limits: The worldwide search is only complete when all 24 shards are present and every tile in the public GLO-90 tile inventory has been processed; otherwise status remains partial.
GLO-90 is a DSM and contains surface objects such as vegetation, buildings, snow and ice.
The global data are coarser than the existing selected GLO-30 local study windows; do not merge the two resolutions into an unqualified score.
Copernicus GLO-90 terrain descriptors do not measure lithology, mineralogy, regolith strength, dust, illumination, radiation, water/ice, subsurface resources or trafficability.

The secondary feature family is an alternative diagnostic from the same DEM, not independent-source validation. Strong rank disagreement is reported and does not change the primary core-only ordering.
The candidate shortlists are bounded to 1,200 ranked windows per target; they are not a complete export of every evaluated window.

ranking_contract.note: The existing complete inventory and candidate rows passed the current core-only ordering and rank-integrity checks. This is ranking-file readiness, not independent analog accuracy or field validation.
